CREATE TABLE external_imports (
	request_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	patient_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	org_id VARCHAR(100), 
	id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	data JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES organisations (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_external_import_request ON external_imports (org_id, request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_external_import_content ON external_imports (org_id, patient_id, content_hash)
REVOKE ALL ON external_imports FROM PUBLIC, "clyra_app"
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON external_imports TO "clyra_app"

CREATE FUNCTION protect_external_evidence() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
    BEGIN
      IF TG_OP <> 'UPDATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'External evidence cannot be removed'; END IF;
      IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.patient_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.patient_id
        OR NEW.org_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.org_id OR NEW.request_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_id
        OR NEW.content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.content_hash
        OR (NEW.data::jsonb - 'status' - 'confirmedAt' - 'visitId' - 'documentId' - 'jobId')
          IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.data::jsonb - 'status' - 'confirmedAt' - 'visitId' - 'documentId' - 'jobId')
        OR OLD.data->>'status' <> 'PENDING_ASSOCIATION' OR NEW.data->>'status' <> 'CONFIRMED'
        OR NEW.data->>'confirmedAt' IS NULL OR NEW.data->>'visitId' IS NULL
        OR NEW.data->>'documentId' IS NULL OR NEW.data->>'jobId' IS NULL
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'External evidence is immutable except association confirmation'; END IF;
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM documents d JOIN visits v ON v.id=NEW.data->>'visitId'
          JOIN extraction_jobs j ON j.id=NEW.data->>'jobId'
          WHERE d.id=NEW.data->>'documentId' AND d.patient_id=NEW.patient_id
          AND d.org_id=NEW.org_id AND d.data->>'rawText'=NEW.data->>'rawText'
          AND d.data->>'visitId'=v.id AND v.patient_id=NEW.patient_id
          AND j.patient_id=NEW.patient_id AND j.data->>'documentId'=d.id
          AND j.data->>'status'='COMPLETED')
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid external evidence association'; END IF;
      RETURN NEW;
    END; $$
CREATE TRIGGER external_evidence_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON external_imports FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_external_evidence()
CREATE TRIGGER external_evidence_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON external_imports FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_event_mutation()
REVOKE DELETE ON documents, medication_entries FROM "clyra_app"
REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE ON discrepancy_decisions FROM "clyra_app"
CREATE TRIGGER discrepancy_decisions_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON discrepancy_decisions FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_event_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER medication_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON medication_entries FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_event_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER document_source_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON documents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_document_source()
CREATE TRIGGER document_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON documents FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_event_mutation()
